name: cline
tagline: Hands your briefs to a self-hosted Cline agent and reports back
description: Keeps the open-source Cline agent installed and running on its own Linux machine, CLI and desktop app alike. Brief it in plain language, a bug to fix, a feature to build, and it drives Cline through the task, then reports what came of it. Handy when you want Cline's workflow without running the environment yourself.
author: weeb3dev
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
